def VTask.prev : {α : Type u_1} -> [DecidableEq α] -> (l : List α) -> (x : α) -> x ∈ l → α :=
fun {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ l) =>
  match l with
  | [] => absurd h (not_mem_nil _)
  | y :: ys =>
    match ys with
    | [] => y -- Singleton list, return the only element
    | z :: zs' =>
      if x = z then
        getLast (z :: zs')
      else
        VTask.prev (y :: ys) x h
